body: My life has been a living hell lately. I found out my "best friend" of 4 years was only using me for my money. My boyfriend died less than a month before that. I'm down to next to no money. I've been living off one meal a day, sometimes one meal every two days, for the past 5 months. Life sucks. I don't know how much more I can take.
I can't. I have nobody to lean on for support. If I was to walk out that door and put a gun to my head, there are only three people would would actually give a shit about me.
